title: Reennooɓe kosam sirlu
intro: E nder leydi ɓuuɓndi, fedde yimɓe waɗii peeje sirlu e les ɓuuɓri niɓɓere. Ɓe ndenndi faandaare wootere, kono anniya maɓɓe ina woɗɗi peewal. Ɓe nganndaano wonde ɓuuɓri diine ina fadi ɓe nde ɓe ɗaani ndee.
clues: Min mbaɗii pellital tiiɗngal, min cikki peeje amen ɗee ngalaa ella.
Min njiɗnoo ko yaltude ko yaawi, hade woɗɓe hay ɓuuɓde.
Min njooɗii e dow leydi ɓuuɓndi, min ngoongɗini ko min keɓi.
Nde min njottii ɗo min njogori yahde ɗoo, min tawi ko nde ɓuuɓnde, nde ɓuuɓnde, min cikki min majjii laawol.
Ndeen min paamii ko goonga ko nokku amen, min ngulli e nder majjere, min njuumti e majjere amen.
Min kuninooma oon subaka yoo min njaltin miskineeɓe e ndema amen, kono jukkungo Alla ari e amen nde min ɗaaninoo, wayli gesa amen bonɗo.

arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verse: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning (68:17)
